page.notes: The initial letter is a decorative woodcut P, joined to "OLEMICA". Doubtful: "Woh" in the heading "Woh in stehet die rüstung zum Krieg?" is read with some uncertainty; the "h" may be a ligature or a different word. The "ab•ordinaria" mark between "ab" and "ordinaria" is a printer's ornament or stop, transcribed as a space. The catchword "fen/" stands alone at the right below the last line. Show-through of the other side is visible at the right edge and was left out.
